CustomField.label: Action Headline
CustomField.description: Imperative one-line used on the Top Issues card instead of the per-record finding title. "Set tax rules on {N} active products" reads as a directive; the per-record title "Product 'Creativity Suite' missing tax rule" reads as a description. {N} interpolates to the affected count at render time. Leave blank to fall back to the existing per-record title.
